title: A Trip to the Station
text:
Maria takes the bus to the train station every morning. The bus is big and yellow. It stops near her school. Today, the bus is late, so Maria waits for ten minutes.

At the station, Maria buys a ticket to the city. The train is fast and very clean. Maria sits next to a window and looks at the trees. She likes to travel by train.

questions.text: How does Maria go to the train station every morning?
What does Maria buy at the station?
How does Maria probably feel about the train?
options: She is bored of the trees

questions.text: Why does Maria wait for ten minutes?
options: She is waiting for a friend

after the time when something should have happened

paragraph_translations: María toma el autobús a la estación de tren todas las mañanas. El autobús es grande y amarillo. Se detiene cerca de su escuela. Hoy, el autobús llega tarde, así que María espera diez minutos.
En la estación, María compra un billete para la ciudad. El tren es rápido y muy limpio. María se sienta junto a una ventana y mira los árboles. Le gusta viajar en tren.
